pins.name: GND
pins.notes: Source of low-side NFET and controller ground. Connect sensitive VFB to this GND at a single point.

pins.name: SW
pins.notes: Switch node between high-side and low-side NFET.

pins.name: VIN
pins.notes: Input supply, drain of high-side NFET.

pins.name: FB
pins.notes: Feedback input; connect to output through resistor divider.

pins.name: EN
pins.notes: Float to enable (internal pull-up current, p9). If controlled, use open-drain or open-collector logic (p9). Optional R4/R5 divider for external UVLO.

pins.name: BOOT
pins.notes: High-side gate drive supply; 0.1 uF capacitor between BOOT and SW.

external_components.role: input decoupling capacitor (ceramic, voltage rating above max VIN)
feedback divider upper resistor R2 (about 100 kOhm, 1 % or better)
feedback divider lower resistor R3 (1 % or better)
output inductor (15 uH for 5 V per table 7-2, VIN = 28 V basis)
output capacitor (44 uF for 5 V per table 7-2; design example uses 2 x 22 uF 25 V X7R)
optional feed-forward capacitor C6 in parallel with R2 (75 pF for 5 V per table 7-2)
optional bulk input capacitor if the source is more than a few inches away (47 uF electrolytic typical)

equations.name: input capacitor RMS current, worst case
minimum output capacitance for load step (2 clock cycles)
maximum output capacitor ESR for ripple
crossover frequency estimate without C6 (keep below 40 kHz)
output capacitor RMS ripple current per capacitor
equations.expression: VOUT * (VIN_MAX - VOUT) / ((12 ** 0.5) * VIN_MAX * L_O * FSW * N_C)

layout_notes.text: VIN and GND traces as wide as possible (impedance and heat dissipation).
Place input and output capacitors as close to the device as possible; provide sufficient vias for them.
Keep the SW trace as short and wide as practical to minimize radiated emissions.
Do not allow switching current to flow under the device.
Use a separate VOUT path to the upper feedback resistor and a Kelvin connection to the GND pin for the feedback path.
Keep the feedback loop away from the switching trace, preferably with ground shield; keep the VFB node trace as small as possible.
GND trace between output capacitor and GND pin as wide as possible.
Layout example: SW node copper pour on internal or bottom layer with vias, additional vias to the GND plane.
Connect sensitive VFB to the GND pin at a single point.

gaps: No max IQ or IOFF given (typ only, p5).
No min/max for RDSON, ISKIP, tSS, tMIN_ON (typ only, p5).
Thermal shutdown threshold inconsistent: 160 C typ rising in EC table (p5) vs 155 C typ with 145 C release in section 6.3.14 (p12); both not production tested.
Feedback pin input current (IFB) not specified; p10 only warns that large divider values make FB input current errors noticeable.
No explicit maximum distance (mm) for input/boot capacitors; layout says as close as possible (p20).

UVLO divider equations 1 and 2 (p10) not transcribed as Python expressions because the extracted fraction layout is ambiguous; read them on p10 if an external UVLO is used. Constants given there: Ip 0.7 uA, Ih 1.55 uA, VENfalling 1.19 V, VENrising 1.21 V.
Equation 9 (p15) is labelled IL(MAX) in the formula but the text calls it the RMS inductor current IL(RMS); transcribed as written (checked on the rendered page).
Table 7-2 recommended values (p17) are based on VIN = 28 V; no L/COUT recommendation for VIN = 12 V.
No hard minimum output capacitance for stability; only design-example values (p16-17).
